# Grad-Pictures.today

## What is Grad-Pictures.today?

Grad-Pictures.today is an AI-powered web application that generates professional graduation and yearbook-style photos for students. It provides an affordable alternative to traditional school photography services.

## How It Works

1. Upload a clear selfie or photo of yourself
2. Customize graduation attire colors (gown, cap, sash/stole)
3. For yearbook photos: optionally provide a reference photo to match your school's gown style
4. For portraits: choose from various backgrounds (studio, campus, forest, outdoor, elegant) and styles (cinematic, realistic, warm, professional, modern)
5. The AI generates your graduation photo in 1-2 minutes

## Use Cases

- Students who missed their school photoshoot
- Those seeking a more affordable graduation photography option
- Anyone wanting to regenerate or refresh their graduation photos
- Students at schools that don't offer professional graduation photography

## Important Usage Guidelines

- Only upload photos that you own or have permission to use
- Reference images for yearbook photos are used solely to match gown style and photography aesthetics, not to copy or replicate any individual
- Users under 18 must have parental or guardian permission to use the service

## Privacy & Data Handling

- Uploaded photos are automatically deleted after 24 hours
- Generated photos are retained for 7 days unless downloaded
- Personal data is handled according to the Privacy Policy
- Consent is required confirming users have rights to uploaded images

## Pricing

- 5 free preview generations per session (with watermark)
- $5 CAD per high-resolution, watermark-free download
- Multiple size presets available (Instagram, 4x6, 5x7, 8x10, yearbook, high-resolution)

## Features

- **Yearbook Photos**: Formal yearbook-style portraits with customizable gown/cap colors and optional reference image matching
- **Graduation Portraits**: Cinematic portraits with background and style selection
- **Color Customization**: Full color picker with school color presets
- **Options**: Cap on/off toggle, diploma toggle
- **Secure Payments**: Powered by Stripe

## FAQ Topics

- How AI generation works
- Photo safety and privacy
- Free preview details
- Download options and pricing
- Reference photo usage
- Generation timing
- Satisfaction policy
- Age requirements
- Supported file formats
- Refund process

## Technical Stack

- Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS
- AI generation via OpenRouter (Claude model)
- Storage on Cloudflare R2
- Payments via Stripe
